scenarios.title: A｜附近景点
scenarios.setting: 在“询问旅游与安全信息”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“附近景点”。

turns.prompt: 你想请对方推荐酒店附近值得游览的地方，会怎么说？

choices.text: Are there any interesting places to visit near the hotel?

feedback.naturalExpression: Are there any interesting places to visit near the hotel?
feedback.explanation: 先确认有没有所需的物品、服务或安排，为后面的选择提供依据。

choices.text: What would you recommend seeing nearby?

feedback.naturalExpression: What would you recommend seeing nearby?
feedback.explanation: 用“What”明确提出所缺的信息，请对方补充说明，而不是让对方猜自己哪里没听懂。

choices.text: Are there any attractions within walking distance?

feedback.naturalExpression: Are there any attractions within walking distance?
feedback.explanation: 先确认有没有所需的物品、服务或安排，为后面的选择提供依据。

choices.text: What are some must-see places around here?

feedback.naturalExpression: What are some must-see places around here?
feedback.explanation: 用“What”明确提出所缺的信息，请对方补充说明，而不是让对方猜自己哪里没听懂。

choices.text: What interesting place can I go near here?

feedback.naturalExpression: Are there any interesting places to visit near the hotel?
feedback.explanation: 去某个地点通常说“go to”，多个可选景点用“places”；也可直接问附近有哪些值得去的地方。

turns.text: The old town is about ten minutes away, and there’s also a museum nearby.

turns.prompt: 你想请对方推荐适合自己时间安排的景点，会怎么说？

choices.text: Which one would you recommend if I only have a few hours?

feedback.naturalExpression: Which one would you recommend if I only have a few hours?
feedback.explanation: 加上条件说明请求或安排的适用范围，让对方可以结合实际限制回应。

choices.text: How long does it take to walk to the old town?

feedback.naturalExpression: How long does it take to walk to the old town?
feedback.explanation: “How long”询问持续时长，而不是具体几点。

choices.text: Is the museum worth visiting?

feedback.naturalExpression: Is the museum worth visiting?
feedback.explanation: 用疑问句核对刚谈到的状态或条件，给对方确认和更正的机会。

choices.text: Is there anything else nearby that’s less crowded?

feedback.naturalExpression: Is there anything else nearby that’s less crowded?
feedback.explanation: 主动询问还有哪些选择，原方案行不通时仍能继续商量。

turns.text: If you only have a few hours, I’d recommend the old town. There are plenty of cafés and shops there as well.

turns.prompt: 你想了解游览推荐景点需要做哪些准备，会怎么说？

choices.text: That sounds good. Is it easy to explore on foot?

feedback.naturalExpression: That sounds good. Is it easy to explore on foot?
feedback.explanation: 明确表示接受刚提出的方案，让对方知道可以按这个安排继续。

choices.text: Do I need to buy tickets for anything there?

feedback.naturalExpression: Do I need to buy tickets for anything there?
feedback.explanation: “Do I need”问的是有没有必要或是否必须，帮助分清必做步骤与可选做法。

choices.text: Is there a good time of day to go?

feedback.naturalExpression: Is there a good time of day to go?
feedback.explanation: 先确认有没有所需的物品、服务或安排，为后面的选择提供依据。

choices.text: Great. I’ll check it out. Thanks.

feedback.naturalExpression: Great. I’ll check it out. Thanks.
feedback.explanation: “will”在这里交代接下来的决定或行动，让对方知道自己会怎样继续。

scenarios.title: B｜当地安全情况
scenarios.setting: 在“询问旅游与安全信息”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“当地安全情况”。

turns.prompt: 你想了解酒店周边的安全情况，会怎么说？

choices.text: Is this area generally safe?

feedback.naturalExpression: Is this area generally safe?
feedback.explanation: 用疑问句核对刚谈到的状态或条件，给对方确认和更正的机会。

choices.text: Is the neighborhood around the hotel safe to walk around?

feedback.naturalExpression: Is the neighborhood around the hotel safe to walk around?
feedback.explanation: 用疑问句核对刚谈到的状态或条件，给对方确认和更正的机会。

choices.text: Are there any areas nearby I should avoid?

feedback.naturalExpression: Are there any areas nearby I should avoid?
feedback.explanation: 先确认有没有所需的物品、服务或安排，为后面的选择提供依据。

choices.text: Is there anything I should be careful about around here?

feedback.naturalExpression: Is there anything I should be careful about around here?
feedback.explanation: 先确认有没有所需的物品、服务或安排，为后面的选择提供依据。

choices.text: Is here safe?

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: Is this area generally safe?
feedback.explanation: “here”通常不直接作这个问句的主语；可说“Is it safe here?”，明确问这里是否安全。

turns.text: The area around the hotel is generally safe, but you should still keep an eye on your belongings in crowded places.

turns.prompt: 你想了解当地出行和游览时需要注意的安全问题，会怎么说？

choices.text: Are pickpockets common around the tourist areas?

feedback.naturalExpression: Are pickpockets common around the tourist areas?
feedback.explanation: “pickpockets”指扒手，询问时能把安全顾虑具体到财物被偷的风险。

choices.text: Is public transportation safe to use at night?

feedback.naturalExpression: Is public transportation safe to use at night?
feedback.explanation: “transportation”指交通安排，适合确认如何前往另一个地点。

choices.text: Are there any streets you’d recommend avoiding?

feedback.naturalExpression: Are there any streets you’d recommend avoiding?
feedback.explanation: 先确认有没有所需的物品、服务或安排，为后面的选择提供依据。

choices.text: Is it okay to carry my phone out in public?

feedback.naturalExpression: Is it okay to carry my phone out in public?
feedback.explanation: 用疑问句核对刚谈到的状态或条件，给对方确认和更正的机会。

turns.text: The main tourist areas are usually fine, but be careful with your phone and wallet in crowded places.

turns.prompt: 你想回应对方的帮助或安排，表达谢意，会怎么说？

choices.text: Got it. Thanks for the advice.

feedback.naturalExpression: Got it. Thanks for the advice.
feedback.explanation: 感谢后面说明具体原因，让对方知道哪项帮助对自己有用。

choices.text: That’s helpful. I’ll be careful.

feedback.naturalExpression: That’s helpful. I’ll be careful.
feedback.explanation: “that’s helpful”明确表示信息或帮助有用，让对方知道这次回应解决了需要。

choices.text: Thanks. I appreciate the warning.

feedback.naturalExpression: Thanks. I appreciate the warning.
feedback.explanation: “I appreciate”表达对帮助、坦诚或付出的感谢，后面点明感谢对象更具体。

scenarios.title: C｜晚上是否适合独自外出
scenarios.setting: 在“询问旅游与安全信息”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“晚上是否适合独自外出”。

turns.prompt: 你想确认附近是否适合夜间独自外出，会怎么说？

choices.text: Is it safe to walk around here alone at night?

feedback.naturalExpression: Is it safe to walk around here alone at night?
feedback.explanation: 用疑问句核对刚谈到的状态或条件，给对方确认和更正的机会。

choices.text: Would you recommend going out alone in this area at night?

feedback.naturalExpression: Would you recommend going out alone in this area at night?
feedback.explanation: 先确认后续安排能否实现，便于对方说明条件、时间或限制。

choices.text: Is it okay to walk back to the hotel late at night?

feedback.naturalExpression: Is it okay to walk back to the hotel late at night?
feedback.explanation: 用疑问句核对刚谈到的状态或条件，给对方确认和更正的机会。

choices.text: Is the area around the hotel busy in the evening?

feedback.naturalExpression: Is the area around the hotel busy in the evening?
feedback.explanation: 用疑问句核对刚谈到的状态或条件，给对方确认和更正的机会。

choices.text: Can I go outside alone at night?

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: Is it safe to walk around here alone at night?
feedback.explanation: “Can I go …?”可能像在问是否允许；若关心安全，可直接问“Is it safe to …?”。

turns.text: The streets around the hotel are usually quite busy until around midnight, but I’d avoid some of the quieter side streets late at night.

turns.prompt: 你想了解哪些地方需要特别留意或避免前往，会怎么说？

choices.text: Which areas should I avoid?

feedback.naturalExpression: Which areas should I avoid?
feedback.explanation: 征求建议或确认下一步，适合流程不熟悉时请对方指导。

choices.text: Would it be better to take a taxi back late at night?

feedback.naturalExpression: Would it be better to take a taxi back late at night?
feedback.explanation: 先确认后续安排能否实现，便于对方说明条件、时间或限制。

choices.text: Is the main road well lit?

feedback.naturalExpression: Is the main road well lit?
feedback.explanation: 用疑问句核对刚谈到的状态或条件，给对方确认和更正的机会。

choices.text: Are there usually people around after ten?

feedback.naturalExpression: Are there usually people around after ten?
feedback.explanation: 用时间短语标明时点或持续时长，让对方能据此安排，而不只知道一个模糊的“晚点”。

turns.text: The main road is well lit. If you’re coming back very late, I’d recommend taking a taxi.

turns.prompt: 你想表示理解对方的解释或立场，会怎么说？

choices.text: That makes sense. Thank you.

feedback.naturalExpression: That makes sense. Thank you.
feedback.explanation: 用简短感谢接住对方的帮助或答复，表示已经收到这份好意。

choices.text: Okay, I’ll stay on the main streets.

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay, I’ll stay on the main streets.
feedback.explanation: “will”在这里交代接下来的决定或行动，让对方知道自己会怎样继续。

choices.text: Thanks. I’ll take a taxi if I’m out late.

feedback.naturalExpression: Thanks. I’ll take a taxi if I’m out late.
feedback.explanation: “will”在这里交代接下来的决定或行动，让对方知道自己会怎样继续。

choices.text: Good to know. I appreciate the advice.

feedback.naturalExpression: Good to know. I appreciate the advice.
feedback.explanation: “good to know”表示这条信息有用，是接收建议或说明后的简短回应。
